subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported file/media-content opt-out, and what canonical config shape and default should own it?
rationale: Current code does not define `ignoreFileContent`, so the remaining work is a new channel policy/config decision rather than a repair of an established documented setting.

options.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches inbound file/media messages to placeholder-only context when enabled.

options.title: Design Shared Media Policy
options.body: Pause this issue until maintainers choose a cross-channel attachment-ingestion policy if the same opt-out should apply beyond Feishu.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Keep the current media behavior and clarify that Feishu supports media size limits but not an `ignoreFileContent` switch.

recommendation.title: Add Feishu Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented top-level and per-account Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches inbound file/media messages to placeholder-only context when enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman has the clearest recent merged history on Feishu media behavior and docs, including the most relevant media-surface PR.
